correctness.rationale: With B=1+alpha xi>xi, R(x)=(x+xi)/(B+x) is strictly increasing. Logistic prey comparison first gives limsup x<=K. Predator comparison at critical delta=eta R(K) gives y->0; lower logistic comparison then x->K. The exact stable-filter ODE for w=(K-x)/y has coefficient -1+o(1) and forcing ->A=K/(B+K), so w->A. Taylor R(x)-R(K)=-R′(K) A y+o(y) gives y′=-beta y^p-Lambda y^2+o(y^2), Lambda=eta K(B-xi)/(B+K)^3. For 0<r=p-1<1, u=y^-r obeys u′=r beta+r Lambda u^(-(1-r)/r)(1+o(1)), yielding finite shift for r<1/2, logarithm at r=1/2, and fractional-power correction for 1/2<r<1; at p=2 t y->1/(beta+Lambda). Our independent high-precision solve_ivp at T=5000 verified (K-x)/y=0.57173,0.57166,0.57158,0.57158 for p=1.4,1.5,1.75,2 vs A=0.57143. Initial finite numerical test was unstable due near-zero y absolute tolerance; rerunning with tighter tolerance resolved it, not a mathematical contradiction.
